我们不断前进的力量之源，是传承百年的红色基因。

issues.detail: 题干未保留明确字数要求，不能用解析器现状冒充完整原题约束

boundary: Actual body lengths exclude source URLs, authorship labels and teacher commentary. A compliant alternative body can satisfy the task while historical versions remain reviewable. Ambiguous original word limits remain explicit review candidates. Missing entire papers, source factual truth, actual exam scores, and unavailable original conditions are separate inventory findings.
